questions.question: What famous summary of true religion appears in Micah 6?
options: To bring to him many thousands of rams and ten thousand rivers of oil
To offer up his own firstborn child as a payment for his transgression
To build a grand and glorious temple high upon the holy mountain
To do justice, love kindness, and walk humbly with your God
questions.answer: To do justice, love kindness, and walk humbly with your God

questions.question: What does Micah 6 say God requires rather than thousands of rams or rivers of oil?
options: Justice, kindness, and humility before God
Strength, courage, and great victory in war
questions.answer: Justice, kindness, and humility before God

questions.question: Micah 6 includes God's 'controversy' (lawsuit) with his people, recalling the exodus.
What does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love _____, and to walk humbly with your God?
He has told you, O man, what is _____.
